individuals.title: Edit Check
individuals.quote: Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing.

individuals.title: Editing Team
individuals.quote: The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor

individuals.title: Reference check
individuals.quote: **Reference check**

individuals.title: Paste Check
individuals.quote: **Paste Check**

individuals.title: Tone check
individuals.quote: **Tone check**

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode
individuals.quote: **Suggestion Mode**

individuals.title: TextMatch
individuals.quote: **TextMatch**

individuals.title: Newcomers and Junior Contributors confidence objective
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful.

individuals.title: Moderators notice quality improvements objective
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Newcomers and Junior Contributors
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers/moderators
individuals.quote: **Experienced volunteers/moderators** – need to do more work reverting low-quality edits

individuals.title: Inexperienced volunteers
individuals.quote: **Inexperienced volunteers** – become disappointed and frustrated when the good-faith change(s) they arrived to the wiki seeking to make are undone

individuals.title: Visual editor does not make people aware of policies
individuals.quote: the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Reference Edit Check activation conditions
individuals.quote: A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing

individuals.title: Moderators must be able to configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: The Editing Team thinks it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated.

individuals.title: Multi-Check A/B Test
individuals.quote: we ran an A/B test with 12 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Reference Check A/B Test
individuals.quote: we conducted an A/B test with 15 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Multi-Check
individuals.quote: Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025.

individuals.title: Mobile publishing step
individuals.quote: The first version of Edit Check will introduce a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow

individuals.title: Desktop siderail
individuals.quote: This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new "siderail."

individuals.title: Special:EditChecks
individuals.quote: Clearer and more accurate details in `Special:EditChecks` which shows the local configuration

individuals.title: Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresentation
individuals.quote: People from Sub-Saharan Africa are underrepresented within the movement

individuals.title: Increase quality of edits outcome
individuals.quote: Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace

individuals.title: Edit Check too resource intensive risk
individuals.quote: Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale

individuals.title: Reference Check increased quality finding
individuals.quote: Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**.

individuals.title: Reference Detection design
individuals.quote: Reference Detection

relationships.quote: Several features are available within Edit Check:
Several features are available within Edit Check:
To learn whether the Multi-Check was effective at causing, newcomers to publish new content edits that include references
To learn whether the Reference Edit Check is effective at causing **newcomers to make edits they intended and experienced volunteers value**
To equip newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa with the know-how and tools
